page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Heading "2. DE EORVNDEM SVC-cessibus." between paragraphs, then running text, then heading "3. DE CAPTIVITATE Iudæorum." and a final paragraph. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: tum boum tuorū,nec greges ouium tua-rum,donec perdat te. Deut.28.50.51.
Vos uerò, ô Iudæi, transgressores estis legis diuinæ. Ergo ne uobis uideatur incredibile aut [illegible, ~9 letters], quod prædixi, futurum ut Chaldæi diripiant uestras & aliarum Gentium opes.
main_text.head: 2. DE EORVNDEM SVC-cessibus.
main_text.p: Sicut se habet uetus Orietalis seu Subsolanus ad plagas[?],arbores,frutices & suffrutices: ita se habebit hostis Chaldæus erga Iudæos. Sed uehementissimus ille & ures uentus obstatia omnia prosternit,uirentia adurit,ut arescat. Ita igitur etiā hostis Chaldæus uim omne sibi oppositam leui momento impulsam prosternet,& uigorem eius omne extinguet & auferet.
main_text.head: 3. DE CAPTIVITATE Iudæorum.
main_text.p: Leuit.26.33.Vos autem dispergā in Getes, & euaginabo post uos gladium: eritq; terra uestra desolata,& ciuitates uestræ destru-ctæ. 34.Tunc perficiet terra sabbata sua, cunctis diebus quibus desolata fuerit:uos autem eritis in terra inimicorum uestrorum. Itaq; nō dubium uobis esse debet de ἀχμαλω-σίας[?]

page.notes: Greek word after "aut" is unreadable on the scan (about 9 letters); marked as illegible. The catchword at the lower right is Greek and partly blurred; read as σίας with [?]. "plagas" is doubtful (the letter could be t or g). "uirentia" is split across the line end "prosternit,ui / rentia" without a visible hyphen; written whole. "Orietalis" and "ures" are as printed. Long s is normalised to s; the printed page number may be 109 but the digits are faint.
